name_reason: Convention-compliant data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain=resource, descriptor=portrait_sheet) with a _ptr suffix that correctly reflects the uint32 pointer slot. No Ghidra address residue. 'portrait_sheet' accurately names the dominant content; the sheet also packs HP-panel / weapon-hit / spell sprites, but the src/Ghidra comments document that breadth, and the sibling FDOTHER index-5 sheet uses the parallel form data_fd2_ui_anim_sprite_sheet_ptr. No compelling unambiguous rename.
purpose: Base pointer of the loaded portrait / combat-panel sprite sheet (FDOTHER.DAT resource index 6); source atlas for combat/spell/warp/speech-bubble sprite blits.
logic_summary: uint32 address slot holding the malloc'd buffer returned by fd2_load_dat_resource(<FDOTHER.DAT name>, prior_ptr, 6). Zero-initialized in the image (.object2 / BSS); first use is the load-time write. Sole writer is main @ 0x25BF4, which passes the prior value (NULL on first call) so the loader frees-then-reloads. Readers treat it as a sprite-sheet base address: passed directly as the sheet argument to fd2_alloc_and_blit_indexed_sprite_chunk, and indexed via an in-buffer offset table to resolve each packed sub-sprite. Readers: fd2_render_combat_combatant_panels (VS HP panels, sprite 0x30=attacker panel), fd2_animate_attack_hit_sequence (weapon-hit sprites), fd2_animate_combat_speech_bubbles, fd2_animate_spell_impact_per_target, fd2_composite_chars_with_spell_effect_overlay, fd2_animate_warp_teleport_char, fd2_animate_warp_portal_open_at, and the orphan fd2_execute_aoe_spell_with_caster_portrait_radial_scatter.
datatype: uint32 (resource buffer base pointer; engine-wide DAT-resource pointer convention)
element_semantics: Single 32-bit address slot. Points to the start of the FDOTHER index-6 sprite-sheet buffer, whose layout is a small in-buffer offset table (4-byte entries: *(uint32*)(base + 6 + idx*4) gives a byte offset, added back to base to reach the packed sub-sprite pixel data) followed by the packed sprite bitmaps. NULL before the load-time write.
notes: is_const=false: it is written at runtime by main (one WRITE xref at 0x25d2e), so it is a mutable BSS pointer slot, not read-only. src comment block (src/life/main.c lines 541-560) was already accurate and precise -> comment_verdict=keep, no Edit made. Ghidra data PLATE_COMMENT at 0x53AD1 was null -> created a concise summary via run_script_inline (CodeUnit.setComment PLATE_COMMENT) reflecting the src conclusion. No logic/equivalence issues found. Name recorded as keep only; no rename applied (Stage 2 handles renames). Read-memory at 0x53AD1 = all zeros (consistent with zero-init BSS pointer).
